answer_1.quote: We utilize six benchmarks ranging general instruction-following, truthful question answering, retrieval-augmented generation, and clinical report generation with both metric-based and LLM-based judgments.

answer_2.quote: we employ metric-based judgment using ROUGE score to evaluate the similarity between generated responses and references

answer_3.quote: we conduct LLM-based judgments on LIMAEval, VicunaEval, WizardLMEval, and TruthfulQA to evaluate the hallucination rate. This metric is determined by whether the generated responses contain conflicting spans with knowledge snippets or factual information, assessed using GPT-4 (gpt-4-0613) as the evaluator.
